name: Lava Boil-Off
author: Brandon
description: Lava normally lasts forever when it boils water into steam. This mod gives lava a small chance to burn itself out: each time a water cell is boiled to steam against lava, there is a 1-in-N chance (default 1 in 5000) that the lava cell also vanishes. Set the rarity below. Turn it off to restore vanilla behaviour.

enabled.descriptionKey: Turn the boil-off effect off without unsubscribing (restores vanilla: lava never vanishes from making steam).

chanceDenominator.descriptionKey: Each time lava boils a water cell into steam, a 1-in-N chance the lava also vanishes. Higher N = rarer / lava lasts longer. Default 100.

showChecker.descriptionKey: Show a small on-screen readout (top-left) with the live roll / vanish counters to confirm the mod is working. Off by default.
